text: True or False: Standard silicon photonic circuits predominantly use the TE polarization because it offers lower propagation loss and better coupling than TM in high-index-contrast waveguides.
explanation: True. High-index-contrast silicon waveguides show large TE/TM splitting, and the TE mode is chosen as standard for its lower loss and superior coupling. The TM mode is more weakly confined and generally lossier in these structures.
